notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA Maine list gives only county, coordinates and gone; there is no register number and no FFLOS or NHLR page in the caches. The story is general Maine lookout context plus the status line, so it is below the usual 120-word floor; no tower-specific build, staffing, fate or site facts were found. Coordinates: the brief point (46.8358, -69.26207) is the FFLA point; the GNIS summit point for Musquacook Mountain in data/sources/peaks_gnis.json (46.85202, -69.29048) is about 2.8 km away, and the tower's own position is not given in any source read. Facebook FFLA Maine chapter posts mention a watchman's camp for the Musquacook tower in the 1960s; seen only as search snippets (login shell on fetch), so not used. Suggested next search: Maine Memory and Aroostook newspaper archives under the mountain name. Two websearch.py queries used.
